prompt: Challenge C001-CH1: We need to detect unusual behaviour on Modbus and BACnet networks without labelled attack data — our clients have never been breached (or do

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Unsupervised anomaly detection and one-class classification for industrial control system protocol traffic can exploit the statistical properties of ICS environments to identify deviations from learned baselines without requiring labelled attack examples.","sources":[{"id":"R1008","field":"bio","quote":"unsupervised anomaly detection and one-class classification for industrial control system protocol traffic, using statistical baseline modelling"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-10477","field":"abstract","quote":"statistical properties of ICS traffic that distinguish it from enterprise IT traffic—determinism, periodicity, limited state space—and how these properties can be exploited by unsupervised methods"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Kernel density estimators and one-class methods based on Mahalanobis distance thresholding can detect Modbus/TCP anomalies with empirical distributions of inter-request intervals, payload values, and function code sequences.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-10472","field":"abstract","quote":"empirical distributions of inter-request intervals, payload values, and function code sequences were estimated using kernel density estimation"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-10472","field":"abstract","quote":"one-class detector based on Mahalanobis distance thresholding over a 20-feature vector was evaluated against 14 manually injected attack scenarios"}]},{"claim":3,"text":"Lightweight online learning algorithms suited to constrained embedded environments can maintain detection performance through recalibration schedules that adapt to normal traffic variation over time.","sources":[{"id":"R1008","field":"bio","quote":"lightweight online learning algorithms suited to constrained embedded environments"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-10472","field":"abstract","quote":"sliding-window recalibration schedule with a 72-hour update period that maintains detection performance without human intervention"}]}]}
